questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q: The chemical entities present in thermosphere of the atmosphere are
questions.solution: The earth's thermosphere also includes the region of the atmosphere, called the ionosphere. The ionosphere is the region of the atmosphere that is filled with charged particles such as $\mathrm{O}_{2}^{+}, \mathrm{O}^{+}, \mathrm{NO}^{+} .$The high temperature in the thermosphere can cause molecules to ionize.
